title: Ghar Main Aya Hai Qatil e Akbar
body:
Akbar Ali Akbar (as)
Shiddat e Sabr Se Mar Jaye Na Maa Akbar (as) Ki
Din Madinay Main Woh Taqdeer Ne Dikhlaya Hai
Jisne Mari Thi Kalajay Main Sinah Akbar (as) Ke
Ban Ke Mehmaan Woh Sajjad (as) Ke Ghar Aya Hai
<<MINI>>
Ghar Main Aya Hai Qatil e Akbar (as) Umme Laila Ko Hogaye Hai Khabar
<<DIVIDER>>
Sheh Taraptay Hain Qabr Ke Andar
Maa Tarapti Hai Qabr Se Bahar
<<MINI>>
Ghar Main Aya Hai Qatil e Akbar (as) Umme Laila Ko Hogaye Hai Khabar
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Phir Wohi Kaifiyat Hai Laila Ki Haal Tha Jo Jawan Ke Lashay Per
Uske Qadmon Ki Ahatain Sun Kar Maa Ne Thama Hua Hai Apna Jigar
<<MINI>>
Ghar Main Aya Hai Qatil e Akbar (as) Umme Laila Ko Hogaye Hai Khabar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Chehra Karbobala Ki Janib Hai Pani Hathon Main Ly Ke Roti Hai
Gir Raha Hai Nigaha Main Maa Ki Ali Akbar Ki Maut Ka Manzar
<<MINI>>
Ghar Main Aya Hai Qatil e Akbar (as) Umme Laila Ko Hogaye Hai Khabar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Umme Laila Sambhal Zainab Ko Kal Yea Shabbir Dy Rahe Thy Sada
Ajj Abid Phuppi Se Kehte Hain Maa Ko Meri Sambhaliye Ja Kar
<<MINI>>
Ghar Main Aya Hai Qatil e Akbar (as) Umme Laila Ko Hogaye Hai Khabar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Qabr e Zahra Se Arhi Hai Sada Isne Mara Hai Mere Baba Ko
Phir Madinay Main Ekk Qayamat Hai Phir Raha Hai Mazar e Paighambar
<<MINI>>
Ghar Main Aya Hai Qatil e Akbar (as) Umme Laila Ko Hogaye Hai Khabar
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ali Akbar Lipat Ke Qadmon Se Keh Rahe Honge Apne Baba Se
Toot Jaye Na Zabt Ka Bandhan Hosla Maa Ko Dijiye Ja Kar
<<MINI>>
Ghar Main Aya Hai Qatil e Akbar (as) Umme Laila Ko Hogaye Hai Khabar
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Sar e Akbar Utha Ke Nezay Per Umme Laila Ko Yea Dikhata Tha
Usko Kaise Woh Bhool Sakti Hai Jis Se Khaye Thy Sham Main Pathar
<<MINI>>
Ghar Main Aya Hai Qatil e Akbar (as) Umme Laila Ko Hogaye Hai Khabar
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Yea Kareemi Se Ruk Nahi Saktay Qatilon Ko Duain Detay Hain
Is Se Pehle Ke Baksh Dain Abid Koi Mukhtar Se Kahay Ja Kar
<<MINI>>
Ghar Main Aya Hai Qatil e Akbar (as) Umme Laila Ko Hogaye Hai Khabar
<<DIVIDER>>
Tumne Ne Sajjad Mujh Ko Pechana Sun Ke Qatil Se Bolay Yea Maula
Tou Woh Ibne e Numair Hi Hai Na Jisne Tukray Kiya Humara Jigar
Kal Thy Mehmaan Hum Teray Zalim Ajj Mehmaan Tou Humara Hai
Aur Kuch Chahiya Bata Tujh Ko Abhi Kehdon Phuppi Se Main Jakar
<<MINI>>
Ghar Main Aya Hai Qatil e Akbar (as) Umme Laila Ko Hogaye Hai Khabar
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Dil Nahi Lagta Ajj Ghar Main Mera Aye Takallum Yea Maa Ka Noha Tha
Tham Kar Boli Mere Bazu Ko Le Chalay Fatima Ki Turbat Per
<<MINI>>
Ghar Main Aya Hai Qatil e Akbar (as) Umme Laila Ko Hogaye Hai Khabar
